text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the summer training camp, Hishi Akebono 
declared she would train on her own, apart 
from Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to stop relying on Biko Pegasus 
and take her training seriously. Though 
feeling a bit lonely, Biko Pegasus cheered 
on her close friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That summer, Hishi Akebono achieved her 
long-awaited maiden victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Hishi Akebono's valiant effort 
ignited Biko Pegasus's motivation once 
again.
